column1: # The RS30 Ultra Max recipe (g0155): steps of tools/build/engine.py, WHEN<TAB>OP<TAB>ARGS. Test images only (trial).
# Base: its own arm32 LineageOS 21 TV GSI built with uffd GC, AOSP test keys. The changes are the X50 test
# image's pieces that apply to this vendor: every APEX uncompressed (no .capex left for apexd's first boot), the debloat
# of debloat.txt (setup wizard, sample launcher, updater, emulator overlays), identity and model props (USB in host
# mode and a TV, as stock), network adb, the vendor app folders hidden (XGIMI-key system apps abort PackageManager), the
# one blobs reader of every model with the X50 family's settings, rs30_blobs_allow.txt and the stock eye-protection
# drawer (in a trial read only from the stock slot), Lumen's key layouts and input configs with the user power keys back to POWER (x50_power_keys.py), and with the
# Mac's signed stage (!unsigned) the platform set on the g0155 key, X50EyeGuard (boot handshake, eye-protection
# fail-safe), X50Projector (menu, remote), X50PowerOverlay (power, gear and projector keys to their apps) and X50TvInput
# (org.lumen.tvinput, the HDMI inputs behind the input and game rows). Since t3 the shared apps of the other Lumen
# images too: Lumen Home as the one HOME (the base launcher goes with debloat_launcher.txt), screen mirroring
# (LumenMiracast, LumenWifiP2pOverlay), AirPlay (the released pin on the g0155 key), the Lumen boot animation and the
# sysconfig that lets every Lumen package run from the first boot. Since beta3 Lumen Setup runs the first start (as on
# the X50, the HB and the Play 6) and TvProvision goes from the signed variants.
# Flags: test (tN), unsigned (--unsigned: the same tree without the stage, a host build check only).
# the stock kernel of the dump has what the base needs: the userfaultfd GC and 32-bit compat
# the pinned base: 32-bit only, built for the uffd GC, its boot image compiled for it (else odrefresh compiles the
# the tree: the base copy with every APEX uncompressed (as the HB and Play 6 images: apexd would unpack each .capex
# during post-fs-data, late for the vendor's PWM watchdog on this 32-bit userspace; original_apex is the same signed
# APEX), the platform set on the g0155 key (a signed APEX goes over the unpacked one), identity and model props
# debloat (debloat.txt): no classpath APEX, no provisioning app, the vendor's VNDK APEX stays; with Lumen Home (the
# signed variants) the base launcher, its recommendations and LineageCustomizer go too (debloat_launcher.txt, as on the
# HB and the Play 6). TvProvision provisions only the unsigned build check: in the signed variants Lumen Setup does
# (as on the X50, the HB and the Play 6), and TvProvision goes, since its HOME filter has Lumen Home's priority 3 and
# Android showed its chooser on the first start of the beta2 trial (apk_roles refuses such a tie)
# the one first-start setting of every image (devices/_image/first_start_prop.txt): English over the vendor's Chinese,
# no fixed time zone over its Asia/Shanghai
# the vendor app folders hidden, network adb, the blobs reader with the eye-protection drawer
# Lumen's power-on sound: init copies the projector app's gate to persist.sys.bootanim.play_sound (lumen-audio BootSound)
# the signal panel's HDMI receiver bridge (apps/core/lumen-signal/image, signal.tsv hdmi_format), the same script as
# the Z9X, the Z9X HB and the other X50 models
# a 0-byte placeholder for every allow-listed file without bind= (the reader binds the verified copy over it); the
# base must not have a real one (tools/devices/test/build_check_test.sh keeps this list equal to the allow list)
# the remote keys, as the X50 image: the vendor's layouts use XGIMI labels this framework rejects (a whole file then
# falls back to Generic.kl: power = mute, gear = F8), so Lumen's layouts and input configs go to /system/product/usr
# (searched first) and the user power keys back to the system POWER. The RS30's own 000d:3840 scancodes (stock
# PICTURE_MODE, PRO_SETTING, BRIGHTNESS) open the picture mode popup, the whole picture page and the light level bar
# (rs30_menu_keys.py after the power edit, keycodes no other layout sends, X50PowerOverlay routes them to the menu).
# Its SHORTCUT_1 / 2 (135 / 136) are the custom keys 1 and 2 of "Remote buttons" (MACRO_1 / 2, devices/_remotes/keys.tsv):
# stock RS30 binds a function to them (SystemUI 848 RemoteCustomKeyUI, remotes B870C / B872C).

column1: # the registry apps, platform apps on the g0155 key, and every APK and APEX of the tree for the Mac's S1 check
# the on-screen keyboard of every model: Lumen Keyboard (apps/LumenKeyboard, the LeanbackIME package with keyboard
# languages and a language key) in LeanbackIME's place; the base's odex of the old APK goes
# Lumen Setup (org.lumen.setup, apps/LumenSetup on the g0155 platform key): HOME 10 on fresh data, the remote, the
# language, Wi-Fi, the time zone from the network and the picture through X50Projector's setup bridge, then it marks
# the device provisioned and disables itself (the X50 image has it from its Z9X base, the HB and the Play 6 build it)
# Lumen Home, the one HOME, with its privileged and runtime permissions. Screen mirroring: a priv-app with two
# privileged permissions and its runtime permissions granted by default, the Wi-Fi Direct device type television for
# Windows as a static RRO; the receiver shows its tiles only where it found Wi-Fi Direct on the unit (the stock vendor
# runs wpa_supplicant with p2p_supplicant.conf and its own Wi-Fi display HAL). AirPlay loads its armeabi-v7a library
# straight from the APK, so the library must be stored and page-aligned there.
# the system package installer in the Lumen look (apps/LumenPackageInstallerOverlay, static RRO, no dex): the GSI's TV
# theme puts the uninstall guided step into a floating dialog (one letter per line), this overlay fixes it for every model
# every Lumen package runs from the first boot (the base stops a new system package with a launcher activity until it
# is opened: z9x.xml for the shared apps and LineageOS statistics off, rs30.xml for the X50 family's apps), and the
# Lumen boot animation (the base's -dark link points at it)
# the staged animation carries the power-on sound part0/audio.wav, every entry Stored (tools/brand/bootanim_check.py)
# the image: the X50 image's erofs flags, one time for every file, a UUID from TAG, the build id and the base sha256
# the mounted image says what it is for: no .capex, nothing of the debloat list, the kept HOME and provisioning,
# Lumen's key layouts with STB_POWER only on the XGIMI BT remotes' own power keys (113 / 185, the remote power key of
# org.lumen.x50.projector, x50_power_keys.py REMOTE), its identity, USB host mode and TV props
